svg.title: Action vocabulary (v1.3): a handler declares its actions, the owner (or an agent with registry.actions.register) registers the namespace, grants and commands may then name it; example github-runner.*

g.text: Action vocabulary (v1.3): a handler declares its actions, the owner (or an agent with registry.actions.register) registers the namespace, grants and commands may then name it; example github-runner.*
with argument schemas, target form host:mini/runners/<runner>, effects irreversible}
manifest_sha256, hosts [host:mini], grantable_by [root, role:admin]} signed by root
[by an agent under a delegable grant]
verify chain to the root; prefix allowed? not session.* etc.
same name again: only the same handler, or a root-signed replacement;
issue-time check: every action in G1 is registered → accept
(a grant on an unregistered action is refused at issue)
Later, a command with action github-runner.restart is checked at the gate
against the manifest's argument schema and the grant chain, then passed
